text: I cancelled our account with XXXX, and they billed a month ahead. I called about this and they refunded. Then they charged us again, said we didn't pay it and sent it to collections. I disputed it with the collection agency with plenty of proof and they never responded. More than 30 days had past and my wife sent an email again that reads : It has been over 30 days since I emailed you requesting that this erroneous debt be corrected. It is your job to respond as to the status, and I can only assume that since I did not hear back from you within the legally allotted time that this has been dismissed. Please respond that this is in fact what you have done. They responded back saying we had to contact XXXX. Today, I received another letter from a different collection agency. I will dispute with them as well. How can we be sent to collections AGAIN when XXXX AND a different debt collector couldn't prove we owed it?

meta.issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
